title: A neighborhood worth exploring
summary: Choose where to begin, then discover a livelier city at street level.
changes: Choose a starting point on highlighted streets, or pick a nearby resident, before entering Street view.
Explore planted entrances, nameplates, shop windows, striped awnings, and warm evening lighting.
Discover street signs, benches, planters, bicycles, lamps, postboxes, crossings, and utility covers.
Watch pedestrians walk through the neighborhood on clear routes.
Walk around buildings and street furnishings with WASD or touch controls, and return to your overview at any time.
